title: 第07章 异蛊回生蛊第08章 年轻当然气盛
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
李元来到二楼。
看到少年的身影，正在处理残蛊的王邻眉头一皱。
“李元你上来干嘛？这里煞气重，快下去。”
“老王，我二转了。”
李元直接说道。
“啊？”
王邻猛地站起，“你说什么？再说一遍？！”
“我现在是二转蛊师了。”
李元重述。
“卧槽！”
王邻瞪大了双眼，良久才吐出他最熟悉的形容词。
“牛逼！”
转念一想。
一个能四天炼制出本命蛊的天才，用一个月时间达到二转蛊师境好像也不必那么惊奇？
“哈哈哈哈哈。”
王邻开怀大笑。
“倒是我平庸太久，忘记了天才该有的样子。”
这次他真的看到了少年进入第九宫内门的希望。
“老王，你身体不好，以后二楼也交给我来管吧。”
李元直截了当说道。

“你小子，还知道关心老头。”
王邻笑了。
李元主要是不想让老王暴殄天物。
那些残蛊才是真正的宝藏。
于他而言可比什么武神宝藏有用多了。
“那以后二楼也交给你吧。”
王邻伸了个懒腰，“看你小子也是个天生牛马，整日在残蛊楼内工作，气血不衰，阳气不减，还更充盈了。”
李元笑道：“所以您颐养天年就行，等我三转了，全交给我来干。”
“好小子，够良心。”
王邻竖起大拇指。
当初见到少年背着爷爷的尸体上山来，他就知道这是一个孝顺的孩子。
聊了一会儿，老王歇息去了。
李元拿起二楼的管理手册。
手册上记载了二楼所有残蛊的入库与出库记录。
他仔细端详，寻找。
很快，他看到了一个稀少品种的名字。
“二转凡蛊，千命蜈蚣。”
“就是你了。”
李元来到一个罐子前，将之揭开，罐中只有一只身体缺了半截的蜈蚣不停扭动。
“都这样了还没死，扭的还挺起劲，生命力很旺盛嘛。”
content_en:
Li Yuan came to the second floor.
Wang Lin, who was dealing with the remaining Gu, frowned when he saw the young man's figure.
"Li Yuan, what are you doing up here? There's a lot of evil here, get down quickly."
"Old Wang, I'm in my second turn."
Li Yuan said directly.
"Huh?"
Wang Lin stood up suddenly, "What did you say? Say it again?!"
"I am now a Level 2 Gu Master."
Li Yuan recapped.
"Fuck!"
Wang Lin's eyes widened, and it took him a long time to utter the adjective he was most familiar with.
"Awesome!"
Then I thought about it.
A genius who can refine his life Gu in four days shouldn't be so surprised to reach the level of second-level Gu Master in one month?
"Hahahahaha."
Wang Lin laughed heartily.
"It's just that I've been mediocre for so long that I forgot what a genius should look like."
This time he really saw the boy's hope of entering the inner gate of the Ninth Palace.
"Old Wang, you are not in good health. From now on, let me take care of the second floor as well."
Li Yuan said bluntly.
"You kid, you still know how to care about the old man."
Wang Lin smiled.
Li Yuan mainly didn't want Lao Wang to waste his wealth.
Those remaining Gu are the real treasures.
To him, it was much more useful than any Martial God treasure.
"Then I'll leave the second floor to you from now on."
Wang Lin stretched his waist and said, "Look at you, you are also a natural genius. You have been working in Cangu Tower all day long. Your energy and blood are not declining, your yang energy is not diminished, and it is even more abundant."
Li Yuan smiled and said: "So you can just take care of yourself until you are old enough. When I turn three, leave it all to me."
"Good boy, very conscientious."
Wang Lin gave a thumbs up.
When he first saw the boy carrying his grandfather's body up the mountain, he knew he was a filial child.
After chatting for a while, Lao Wang went to rest.
Li Yuan picked up the management manual on the second floor.
The manual records the entry and exit records of all the remaining Gu on the second floor.
He looked carefully, searching.
Soon, he saw the name of a rare breed.
"Second-turn mortal gu, centipede with a thousand lives."
"It's you."
Li Yuan came to a jar and opened it. In the jar, there was only a centipede with half of its body missing, twisting and turning.
"It's still like this. It's still alive. It's still twisting vigorously. It has a lot of vitality."
